entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Uromi is a Catholic diocese of the Latin Church of Nigeria. It was created on 14 December 2005 from the Archdiocese of Benin City. Its first bishop was Augustine Obiora Akubeze and the seat the diocese is the Cathedral of St Anthony of Padua in Uromi, Edo State.
